body.statement: SPEC-10.2-32: Every `graph` result carries `root`, the snapshot and `as_of` of its view (and of the base view), and `lens`, the content address of everything else that decides it: the code of the interface and of the engine, the view's trust and profile, and the query with its parameters; one lens over one root gives one result.
